_comment: Story library. Every story has intro (2 pages) + middle (24 pages) + finale (2 pages). A book of N pages (15-30, see pricing.json) uses intro + middle[:N-4] + finale. Captions may use {hero}, {family}, {their}, {them}, {Their}. Speech 'who' may be hero, sk (the sidekick) or c1..c5 (a family member in that slot). 'cast' lists who is drawn on the page: hero, sk, family, or c1..c5. 'scene' is the illustration brief sent to the image model; never ask for text in it. 'category' must be an id in 'categories'; 'interests' are used by the bundle wizard.

ageGroups.name: Tiny Tots
ageGroups.blurb: A big picture and a few warm words on every page, full of familiar faces.

ageGroups.name: Little Explorers
ageGroups.blurb: Short read-aloud adventures with one picture and a few lines per page.

ageGroups.name: Young Heroes
ageGroups.blurb: Comic-style pages with speech bubbles and a proper adventure plot.

ageGroups.name: Super Readers
ageGroups.blurb: Longer stories with twists, mysteries and more to read on every page.

stories.title: {hero} and Barnaby's Bedtime
stories.blurb: Barnaby the patchwork bear has lost his yawn. Can {hero} help him find it before the moon goes to sleep?

sidekick.name: Barnaby
sidekick.desc: a soft patchwork bear with one floppy ear

intro.scene: a cosy bedroom at dusk, a patchwork bear sitting on a cot, yawning, soft blue light
intro.caption: Barnaby the bear was very, very sleepy.

intro.scene: a child in pyjamas hugging the patchwork bear beside a window with a big round moon
intro.caption: {hero} gave Barnaby a hug. Let's find your yawn!

middle.scene: under a bed, a fluffy slipper and a dusty sock peeking out
middle.caption: Under the bed... a sleepy sock!

middle.scene: behind the curtains, a friendly dust bunny waving
middle.caption: Behind the curtains... a dust bunny!

middle.scene: a toy box with a rattle, a teddy and a wooden train
middle.caption: In the toy box... a rattle that goes rattle!

middle.scene: a bathtub full of bubbles and a rubber duck
middle.caption: In the bath... bubbles go pop! No yawn here.

middle.scene: a warm kitchen with a cup of milk steaming on the table
middle.caption: In the kitchen... a warm cup of milk.

middle.scene: a garden at dusk, a snail on a leaf
middle.caption: In the garden... a very slow snail.

middle.scene: a cat curled up asleep on a cushion, purring
middle.caption: On a cushion... a cat, purring softly.

middle.scene: a garden gate with a wind chime, the sky turning deep blue
middle.caption: Out past the gate, the sky turned deep blue.

middle.scene: a hill at night with the big round moon shining above
middle.caption: On the hill, the moon glowed like a lantern.

middle.scene: the moon with a huge round mouth, yawning
middle.caption: The moon gave a huge, big yawn!

middle.scene: a tiny silver yawn floating up like a bubble from the moon
middle.caption: Look! A tiny silver yawn floated up into the sky.

middle.scene: the bear stretching up on tiptoes, reaching for the silver yawn
middle.caption: Barnaby stretched up on his tiptoes...

middle.scene: the child and bear sharing a warm bowl of soup by the fire
middle.caption: Barnaby and {hero} had a little supper.

middle.scene: the bear and child looking up at the moon through the garden gate
middle.caption: They waved at the moon, and the moon waved back.

middle.scene: the child jumping up high to catch the floating yawn
middle.caption: {hero} jumped up... and caught it!

middle.scene: the child holding a glowing silver yawn in cupped hands
middle.caption: Careful, careful. The yawn glowed softly.

middle.scene: the child walking gently down the hill with the bear
middle.caption: Down the hill they went, very gently.

middle.scene: the child carrying the bear back up the stairs to bed
middle.caption: Back up the stairs and into bed.

middle.scene: the bear snuggled under a blanket, the child tucking him in
middle.caption: Barnaby snuggled under the blanket.

middle.scene: the bear's mouth opening wide, the silver yawn sliding in
middle.caption: Then... Barnaby's mouth opened wide.

middle.scene: the bear's eyes closing, the moon glowing through the window
middle.caption: Barnaby's eyes began to close.

middle.scene: the child yawning too, sleepy and happy
middle.caption: {hero} yawned too. What a good yawn!

middle.scene: the moon smiling down, stars twinkling
middle.caption: The moon smiled. The stars twinkled.

middle.scene: family tiptoeing in to kiss the sleepy child goodnight
middle.caption: {family} tiptoed in for goodnight kisses.

middle.scene: a tiny night light glowing in a quiet room
middle.caption: A little light glowed in the room.

middle.scene: the window with the moon peeking in, the bear and child asleep
middle.caption: Everyone was asleep. Shh.

finale.scene: the bedroom at night, the child and the bear asleep under a soft quilt
finale.caption: Snuggled in bed, {hero} and Barnaby slept all night long.

finale.scene: the moon outside the window, smiling, with a yawn of its own
finale.caption: Goodnight, {hero}. Goodnight, Barnaby. Goodnight, moon.

middle.scene: an orange butterfly fluttering over the orange puddle

middle.scene: a yellow paint pot and a grey puddle
middle.caption: Yellow next! Yellow like the sun.

middle.scene: the child and frog both drawing a big rainbow in the mud

middle.scene: a snail sliding along green grass

middle.scene: a blue paint pot and a grey puddle
middle.caption: Blue next, like the sky!

middle.scene: a blue balloon floating above the puddle

middle.scene: a purple paint pot and a grey puddle

middle.caption: The garden was the happiest it had ever been.

stories.title: {hero} and the Moon Garden
stories.blurb: Every night the Moon Garden opens its silver flowers. Tonight one is missing, and only {hero} and the wise owl can find it.

sidekick.name: Professor Hoo
sidekick.desc: a wise owl in round spectacles who grows moonflowers

intro.scene: a moonlit garden with silver flowers closed up tight, a night sky full of stars
intro.caption: Every night the Moon Garden opens its silver flowers.

intro.scene: a child in pyjamas and wellies beside a wise owl wearing round spectacles
intro.caption: Professor Hoo needed a helper. {hero} said yes!

middle.scene: a garden gate made of twisted vines with a glowing keyhole
middle.caption: They walked through the vine gate.

middle.scene: a path of mossy stepping stones across a shimmering stream
middle.caption: Across the stream on mossy stones.

middle.scene: a crowd of glowing fireflies lighting a path through the grass
middle.caption: Fireflies lit the way with twinkles.

middle.scene: a tree with a round door in its trunk, a sleepy squirrel at the window
middle.caption: A tree with a door. Knock, knock!

middle.scene: a sleepy squirrel rubbing its eyes
middle.caption: The squirrel had seen a silver flower roll away.

middle.scene: a silver flower rolling down a hill, a trail of petals behind
middle.caption: The missing flower had rolled down the hill!

middle.scene: a bridge made of rainbows over a dark valley
middle.caption: They crossed a bridge made of rainbows.

middle.scene: a grumpy cloud sitting in the middle of the path
middle.caption: A grumpy cloud sat in the way.

speech.text: Grr, I'm too puffy to move!

middle.scene: the child offering the cloud a warm cup of cocoa
middle.caption: {hero} offered the cloud a warm drink.

middle.scene: the cloud smiling and drifting aside, sunbeams streaming out
middle.caption: The cloud smiled and drifted aside.

middle.scene: the owl tapping a ladder of stars reaching up to the sky
middle.caption: A ladder of stars reached up to the sky.

middle.scene: the child climbing the star ladder, owl flying alongside
middle.caption: Up, up, up the star ladder they climbed.

middle.scene: the owl and child resting on a branch, looking at the night sky
middle.caption: They rested on a branch to catch their breath.

middle.scene: a shooting star streaking across the sky above the garden
middle.caption: A shooting star zipped past, making a wish.

speech.text: I wish for a sunny day!

middle.scene: a hilltop with a moon-moth dancing around a silver lantern
middle.caption: At the top, a moon-moth danced.

middle.scene: the moon-moth pointing towards a dark, empty corner of the sky
middle.caption: The moth pointed at a dark, empty corner.

middle.scene: the child reaching into the dark sky to pull out a silver flower
middle.caption: {hero} reached into the dark corner...

middle.scene: the silver flower shining in the child's hands
middle.caption: The silver flower glowed in {hero}'s hands.

middle.scene: the owl and child flying carefully down the star ladder
middle.caption: Down the star ladder they went, carefully.

middle.scene: the rainbow bridge glowing softly over the garden
middle.caption: Back over the rainbow bridge.

middle.scene: the owl looking very proud with spectacles glinting
middle.caption: Professor Hoo beamed.

middle.scene: the child placing the flower into the empty spot in the garden
middle.caption: {hero} put the flower back in its place.

middle.scene: the garden lighting up, every flower opening like a silver star
middle.caption: One by one, the flowers opened.

middle.scene: the owl hooting happily from a branch
middle.caption: Hoooo! The Moon Garden was whole again.

middle.scene: the moon glowing brightly, sending a silver beam down to the garden
middle.caption: The moon glowed brighter than ever.

middle.scene: the child waving goodnight from the garden gate, owl beside them
middle.caption: Time for bed. Goodnight, Moon Garden!

finale.scene: the child tucked up in bed, dreaming of silver flowers
finale.caption: {hero} fell asleep, dreaming of silver flowers.

finale.scene: the owl and the moon both smiling over a garden of stars
finale.caption: Goodnight, {hero}! Goodnight, Moon!

stories.title: {hero} and the Dragon Who Hiccupped Rainbows

sidekick.desc: a small green dragon who hiccups rainbows

intro.scene: a grassy hill with a little green dragon sitting with hiccups, rainbows popping out
intro.caption: Mango the dragon had hiccups. Hic! A rainbow!

intro.scene: a child giggling beside the dragon while rainbows float up around them
intro.caption: {hero} giggled. Every hiccup made a rainbow!

middle.scene: a rocky mountain path lined with wildflowers
middle.caption: They set off up the mountain path.

middle.scene: a dragon hiccupping a rainbow that lands on a flower
middle.caption: Hic! A rainbow landed on a flower.

middle.scene: a little bird sitting in a bush, looking lost
middle.caption: A little bird sat in a bush. Tweet?

middle.scene: the child building a rainbow bridge for the bird to fly along
middle.caption: {hero} used a rainbow bridge to guide the bird home.

middle.scene: the bird flying into its nest in a tall tree
middle.caption: The bird found its nest and chirped happily.

middle.scene: a wide cave at the top of the hill with a sleepy tortoise
middle.caption: At the top, a wise old tortoise was waiting.

middle.scene: the tortoise with a speech bubble containing a riddle
middle.caption: The tortoise asked a riddle: what has many colours but no paint?

middle.scene: the child thinking hard with a finger on their chin
middle.caption: {hero} thought very hard.

middle.scene: the child answering with a big smile, the tortoise nodding
middle.caption: {hero} answered: 'A rainbow!'

middle.scene: the tortoise handing the dragon a cup of cool water
middle.caption: The tortoise gave Mango a cup of cool water.

middle.scene: the dragon sipping water, a small rainbow fizzing in the air
middle.caption: Sip, sip... hic!

middle.scene: the dragon sneezing a big fountain of colours
middle.caption: Mango sneezed a fountain of colours!

middle.scene: the dragon and child walking past a field of sleepy sheep
middle.caption: They tiptoed past some sleepy sheep.

middle.scene: the dragon hiccupping a rainbow shaped like a heart
middle.caption: Hic! A heart-shaped rainbow!

middle.scene: a river cutting through the hills, a log stuck across it
middle.caption: On the way back, a log blocked the river.

middle.scene: the child and the dragon pushing the log while a rainbow slide appears
middle.caption: Together they pushed. A rainbow slide appeared!

middle.scene: a group of baby ducks sliding down a rainbow into the river
middle.caption: Splash! The ducks slid down the rainbow.

middle.scene: the dragon laughing, his scales shining in the sun
middle.caption: Mango laughed and laughed.

middle.scene: a village with houses and a market, the dragon peeking over the roofs
middle.caption: They passed a sleepy village.

middle.scene: a shopkeeper offering a bowl of ice cream to the dragon
middle.caption: The shopkeeper offered a very big ice cream.

middle.scene: the dragon very carefully licking the ice cream, all quiet
middle.caption: Lick, lick... no hiccups!

middle.scene: the sun setting behind the hills, with a rainbow across the sky
middle.caption: The sun set behind a big rainbow.

middle.scene: the child and dragon sitting together watching the sunset
middle.caption: They watched the sky turn pink and gold.

middle.scene: the dragon yawning, a tiny rainbow yawn floating away
middle.caption: Mango yawned. A tiny rainbow floated away.

middle.scene: the family waving from the garden gate as the child arrives home
middle.caption: {family} waved from the gate.

middle.scene: the child and dragon walking together through a field of flowers
middle.caption: They walked home through the flowers.

finale.scene: a quiet night sky with a faint rainbow above a cosy house
finale.caption: That night, the sky had one small rainbow.

finale.scene: the child and dragon waving goodnight from a window
finale.caption: Goodnight, {hero}! Goodnight, Mango!

stories.title: The Sky-Kite Race of {hero}
stories.blurb: The Sky-Kite Race is tomorrow, but the wind has vanished! {hero} and the fox kite-maker Zara must find the Wind Bottle in the Whispering Woods.

sidekick.name: Zara
sidekick.desc: a clever fox kite-maker who builds kites from old maps

intro.scene: a hilltop town decorated with bunting, huge kites waiting, and not a breath of wind
intro.caption: Tomorrow was the Sky-Kite Race. But the wind had vanished!

speech.text: Without wind, no kite can fly.

intro.scene: a child holding a paper kite beside a clever fox kite-maker with goggles
intro.caption: {hero} had an idea. 'Where did the wind go?'

middle.scene: a map spread on a table with a route marked through a dark forest
middle.caption: Zara unrolled an old map. 'The wind is kept in the Whispering Woods.'

middle.scene: a path into the woods, tall trees whispering in the breeze
middle.caption: Into the Whispering Woods they went.

middle.scene: trees with faces that whisper riddles
middle.caption: The trees whispered: 'Find the way by listening.'

middle.scene: a stream with a rickety bridge and a crow guard
middle.caption: A rickety bridge, and a grumpy crow.

middle.scene: a crow with a shiny hat, looking down its beak
middle.caption: 'Answer me this,' said the crow. 'What gets wetter as it dries?'

middle.scene: the child thinking, with a puzzled frown
middle.caption: {hero} thought: a towel!

middle.scene: the crow laughing and stepping aside to let them cross
middle.caption: 'Clever!' laughed the crow, and stepped aside.

middle.scene: a huge spider web across the path, glistening
middle.caption: Next, a giant web blocked the way.

middle.scene: the child carefully lifting a thread of the web to pass
middle.caption: {hero} lifted the threads one by one.

middle.scene: a secret clearing with a rope bridge over a deep gorge
middle.caption: A secret clearing and a rope bridge.

middle.scene: the rope bridge swaying, the fox steadying it with one paw
middle.caption: The bridge swayed. Zara held it steady.

middle.scene: a stone cottage in the woods with a wooden sign reading Wind Keeper
middle.caption: At the end, a cottage: Wind Keeper.

middle.scene: the fox and child climbing a tall tree to reach a lost ribbon
middle.caption: Zara climbed the tree to reach a lost kite ribbon.

middle.scene: the child catching the ribbon as a gust of wind blows it down
middle.caption: {hero} caught the ribbon as it floated down.

middle.scene: an old owl keeper with a bottle full of swirling wind
middle.caption: The Wind Keeper held up a glowing bottle of wind.

middle.scene: the keeper explaining, a child listening with wide eyes
middle.caption: 'Wind is only lent,' said the Keeper. 'Return it when you're done.'

middle.scene: the child promising, with a hand on heart
middle.caption: {hero} promised to bring it back.

middle.scene: the bottle gently opening, a breeze puffing out
middle.caption: The bottle opened with a puff of breeze.

middle.scene: the wind lifting their hair and twirling leaves
middle.caption: The wind twirled and danced.

middle.scene: a flock of crows watching, and a fox on a fast run towards town
middle.caption: But on the way back, a flock of crows swooped down!

middle.scene: the child running with the wind bottle tucked safely under one arm
middle.caption: They ran, as fast as they could.

middle.scene: the crows chasing, and the fox leading the child around a tree
middle.caption: Zara led the way around the big oak.

middle.scene: the crows giving up, flapping away with their hats
middle.caption: The crows gave up and flapped away.

middle.scene: the town square with kites ready, families waiting
middle.caption: They reached the hill, just in time.

middle.scene: the child pouring the wind gently over the kites
middle.caption: {hero} opened the bottle over the hill.

middle.scene: hundreds of kites lifting into the sky
middle.caption: The kites soared higher and higher.

finale.scene: the race starting, colourful kites rushing across the blue sky
finale.caption: The race began! Kites zoomed across the sky.

finale.scene: the child and fox kite-maker sharing a prize ribbon at sunset
finale.caption: {hero} and Zara shared the prize: a ribbon for teamwork.

intro.caption: Out in the middle of the ocean, the brass whale Tock had stopped.

speech.text: Tock needs his key, and fast!

intro.caption: Captain Marlow handed {hero} a brass telescope. 'Ready, first mate?'

middle.scene: a diving bell lowered into the sea with the child peering out

middle.scene: a bright coral reef with a pufferfish puffing up

middle.scene: a sea turtle with a shell covered in tiny stars

speech.text: Have you seen a brass key?

middle.scene: the child carefully untangling the net with the octopus helping

middle.scene: a grateful octopus waving with all eight arms
middle.caption: The octopus waved all eight arms.

middle.scene: an old brass key glinting in the sand under a broken mast
middle.caption: Then a glint! A brass key in the sand.

middle.scene: the child holding the key as the diving bell rises
middle.caption: Up they went, with the key safe in {hero}'s hand.

middle.scene: the otter captain and child sharing a biscuit on the boat deck
middle.caption: Captain Marlow shared a biscuit on deck.

middle.scene: a shoal of glowing jellyfish lighting up the dark water
middle.caption: Glowing jellyfish lit up the dark water.

middle.scene: a school of dolphins escorting the boat home
middle.caption: Dolphins leapt alongside the boat.

middle.scene: a storm cloud forming on the horizon, waves rising
middle.caption: But a storm was brewing on the horizon.

middle.scene: the boat rocking in the waves, the child holding the ropes
middle.caption: The boat rocked. {hero} held the ropes steady.

middle.scene: a lighthouse beam cutting through the storm, guiding the boat

middle.scene: a bolt of lightning in the distance, the otter captain at the wheel
middle.caption: The captain steered straight through the waves.

middle.scene: the storm passing, the sky turning gold

middle.scene: a rainbow arching over the calm sea

middle.scene: the child and captain looking at a map, pointing at the whale's location

finale.scene: the child, the otter captain and the brass whale at the harbour

stories.title: The Secret of Cinder Lighthouse
stories.blurb: The lamp at Cinder Lighthouse has vanished the night before the town's big vote on whether to close it. {hero}, junior detective, teams up with Inspector Gull to solve the case.

sidekick.name: Inspector Gull
sidekick.desc: a seagull detective in a tweed hat, with a magnifying glass

intro.scene: a foggy seaside town at dusk, a lighthouse with a dark, empty lantern room
intro.caption: The lamp at Cinder Lighthouse had vanished in the night.

speech.text: Lighthouses don't lose their lamps. Someone took it.

intro.scene: a junior detective with a notebook beside a seagull in a tweed hat
intro.caption: {hero}, junior detective, had a notebook and a plan.

middle.scene: the lighthouse keeper's cottage with a sign: Closing Next Week
middle.caption: The keeper's cottage had a notice: 'Lighthouse to close.'

middle.scene: a town hall full of worried residents holding signs
middle.caption: At the town hall, the vote was tomorrow.

middle.scene: a mayor in a big chair with a clipboard, looking stern
middle.caption: The mayor was firm: the lighthouse would close.

middle.scene: the child asking the mayor a question while the mayor waves them off
middle.caption: {hero} asked the mayor where she was last night.

middle.scene: the mayor at a dinner party in a photo on the wall, with an alibi
middle.caption: The mayor had an alibi: a dinner, with photos.

middle.scene: footprints in sand leading from the lighthouse to the rocks
middle.caption: Footprints led from the lighthouse to the rocks.

middle.scene: a fisherman mending nets, looking nervous

speech.text: Did you see anyone last night?

middle.caption: 'Only the wind,' he said, not quite meeting their eyes.

middle.caption: A sticky note on a crate: 'Lamp, keep it warm.'

middle.caption: At the bakery, a girl quickly hid something behind her back.

middle.scene: the girl revealing a lantern wrapped in a towel, glowing softly
middle.caption: The lantern glowed softly under the towel!

middle.scene: the girl explaining with a sad smile, the keeper's granddaughter
middle.caption: 'I'm Ada,' she said. 'I took it. I didn't want the light to go out.'

middle.scene: Ada and the detective examining an old crate in a dark storeroom
middle.caption: They searched the dusty storeroom for more clues.

middle.scene: a torn photo of the lighthouse keeper with his granddaughter
middle.caption: A torn photo showed the keeper with Ada as a little girl.

middle.scene: Ada and the detective sitting together on the harbour wall
middle.caption: Ada explained the plan to save the lighthouse.

middle.scene: the lighthouse keeper's old logbook open on a desk, with children's drawings
middle.caption: The keeper's logbook was full of drawings by local children.

middle.scene: a poster being drawn by children, showing the lighthouse at night
middle.caption: The children were making posters to save it.

middle.scene: the child and the detective walking to the town hall with a box of posters

middle.caption: The mayor studied the drawings in silence.

middle.caption: Ada carried the lamp home to the tower.

middle.scene: the lamp lit at the top of the tower, beams sweeping over the sea

middle.scene: the child writing in a notebook, the case neatly filed

middle.scene: the lighthouse glowing across the bay, the town celebrating

middle.scene: family cheering on the harbour as the lighthouse glows

finale.scene: the lighthouse on a calm night, one bright beam across the sea

finale.scene: the detective tipping its hat in a window of a seaside cottage

stories.title: {hero}'s Robot Inventors' Club
stories.blurb: {hero} and the Inventors' Club build a robot from spare parts for the school science fair. When it runs off, the team must invent a clever way to bring it back.

sidekick.name: Sprocket
sidekick.desc: a friendly robot built from old tins, with a spinning antenna

intro.scene: a messy school workshop with wires, gears, tin cans and a half-built robot
intro.caption: The Inventors' Club had one week to build a robot for the science fair.

intro.scene: a child wearing safety goggles beside a team of young inventors
intro.caption: {hero} was the club's team leader. 'Let's test Sprocket!'

middle.scene: the robot's wheels spinning on a workbench, sparks flying
middle.caption: Sprocket's wheels whirred. Sparks flew!

middle.scene: the child adjusting a sensor with a small screwdriver
middle.caption: {hero} tuned the sensor with a tiny screwdriver.

speech.text: Let's try walking in a line.

middle.scene: the robot rolling in a straight line across the room
middle.caption: Sprocket rolled straight. Hooray!

middle.scene: the robot turning, then zooming off out the door
middle.caption: But at the next corner, Sprocket zoomed off!

middle.scene: a school corridor with a trail of footprints and dropped screws
middle.caption: The team followed a trail of dropped screws.

middle.scene: the team studying a map of the school, marking the path
middle.caption: They drew a map of the school.

middle.scene: the robot stuck at a door, its wheels spinning on a rug
middle.caption: Sprocket was stuck on a rug, spinning in circles.

middle.scene: the team inspecting the robot, the child holding a torch
middle.caption: 'Its sensor is dirty,' said {hero}.

middle.scene: the team cleaning the sensor with a cloth
middle.caption: They cleaned the sensor carefully.

middle.scene: the robot now moving smoothly, avoiding a chair in its path
middle.caption: Sprocket avoided the chair perfectly!

middle.scene: a whiteboard full of equations and a sketched robot design
middle.caption: The team scribbled equations on the whiteboard.

middle.scene: the child demonstrating to the team how the robot's wheel turns
middle.caption: {hero} explained how the wheels turn the robot.

middle.scene: the team sketching a new design for a robot arm on a notepad
middle.caption: The team sketched a robot arm that could pick things up.

middle.scene: the robot arm picking up a small block and placing it on a tower
middle.caption: The claw worked! It stacked the blocks neatly.

middle.scene: the robot carrying a small cup of water without spilling
middle.caption: Sprocket carried a cup without spilling a drop.

middle.scene: the robot's antenna lighting up as it senses a friend
middle.caption: Sprocket's antenna flashed. A new friend!

middle.scene: a friendly classmate, a girl with a pen behind her ear, joining the team
middle.caption: Priya from class joined the team with a new idea.

middle.scene: the team testing the robot with a teacher watching
middle.caption: The teacher watched as they tested Sprocket.

middle.scene: the robot rolling smoothly down a corridor, the team cheering
middle.caption: Sprocket rolled all the way down the corridor!

middle.scene: the team fixing a loose wire, a small spark, and an annoyed robot
middle.caption: A loose wire! Sprocket sputtered.

middle.scene: the robot now displaying a little happy face on its screen
middle.caption: Sprocket's screen showed a happy face.

middle.scene: the team putting the robot on the science fair display table
middle.caption: On the day of the fair, Sprocket was ready.

middle.scene: families and judges walking around the science fair hall
middle.caption: Judges and families came to see the inventions.

middle.scene: the child explaining to a judge, pointing at the robot's sensor
middle.caption: {hero} explained how the sensor worked.

speech.text: We fixed a bug, which is data!

middle.scene: the robot performing a neat trick, drawing a circle on the table
middle.caption: Sprocket drew a perfect circle with a marker.

middle.scene: the judge smiling and writing notes on a clipboard
middle.caption: The judge was impressed.

finale.scene: the inventors' workshop at night, Sprocket charging on the bench
finale.caption: That night, Sprocket charged up for the next invention.

finale.scene: the child writing the next big idea in a notebook, the robot beside them
finale.caption: 'Next project?' asked Priya. {hero} grinned.
